tool_input.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import subprocess, hashlib, json, pathlib
R="/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec105/fx"
P=R+"/plugins/system-spec-harness"
S=R+"/system-spec/spec-state.json"
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
vcm=P+"/scripts/validate-coverage-matrix.py"
s0,v0=sha(S),sha(vcm)
def run(argv):
    r=subprocess.run(argv,capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=R); return {"exit_code":r.returncode,"stdout":r.stdout,"stderr":r.stderr}
mv={"state_path":S,"state_sha256":s0,"validator_path":vcm,"validator_sha256":v0,
 "loop":run(["python3",vcm,"--matrix",S]),"require_complete":run(["python3",vcm,"--matrix",S,"--require-complete"])}
assert sha(S)==s0 and sha(vcm)==v0
print(json.dumps(mv,ensure_ascii=False,indent=1))
A=P+"/skills/assign-system-spec-completeness-evaluator/scripts/aggregate-completeness.py"
for argv in [["--matrix",S,"--require-complete"],["--source-citation",R+"/system-spec/fetched-references.json","--state",S,"--repo-root",R],["--knowledge-graph"]]:
    r=subprocess.run(["python3",A]+argv,capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=R)
    print("=== AGG",argv[0],r.returncode); print(r.stdout); print(r.stderr)
EOF
